summary: Initializes or reinitializes a mutex on an object. If the ready flag byte at this+0x28 is set and CloseHandle on the stored handle at this+0x20 succeeds, the handle slot is cleared to 0. A fresh unnamed mutex is then created with CreateMutexA using a SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES struct (nLength=12, no descriptor, inheritable) and stored at this+0x20; when creation succeeds the ready flag at this+0x28 is set to 1. Returns the ready flag byte. Invoked by sub_57BA10.

operations.description: If the ready flag byte at this+0x28 is set, attempt to close the existing mutex handle at this+0x20 via CloseHandle.
When the flag is set and CloseHandle succeeds, clear the handle slot at this+0x20 to 0.
Initialize the SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES for the new mutex: nLength=12, lpSecurityDescriptor=0, bInheritHandle=1.
CreateMutexA(&MutexAttributes, 0, 0) creates an unnamed mutex; the returned HANDLE is stored at this+0x20.
If the new handle at this+0x20 is non-null, set the ready flag byte at this+0x28 to 1.
Return the ready flag byte at this+0x28.
